Players Committee card image of [[Part Of The Tribe]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on your non-alien, non-Jedi character. When deployed, choose a species of an alien here. Character gains that species. Aliens of that species may deploy (for -1 Force if non-unique) or move here as a 'react'. While on Endor, adds one [Light Side Force] icon.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/partofthetribe.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/partofthetribe.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
